architecture: Conv1D(32, kernel=3, causal) -> MaxPooling1D(2) -> LSTM(32) -> Dropout(0.20) -> Dense(32, ReLU) -> Dense(horizon)
walk_forward_method: Fixed trained model; final test origins spaced by 63 observations so target blocks do not overlap across reported horizons.
selection_method: Per-currency, per-horizon selection on a separate chronological selection partition not used for gradient updates or early stopping. Lowest validation MAE wins; RMSE and absolute-error standard deviation break ties.
calibration_method: Method-specific empirical absolute log-error quantiles from a separate chronological calibration partition. Calibration origins are thinned by stride 5; forecast windows can overlap, so intervals are descriptive scenario bands and not formal conformal coverage guarantees.

metric_definitions.directional_accuracy_pct: Not applicable to random walk because it predicts no directional change.
